To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
shoot tip encapsulation is a suitable approach for germplasm conservation of jojoba.
shoot tips excised from proliferated shoot derived from nodal segments of jojoba were encapsulated successfully in calcium alginate for germplasm storage and distribution.
shoot tips excised from proliferated shoots derived through in vitro nodal explants were successfully encapsulated in calcium- alginate beads for exchange and distribution of germplasm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient protocol for encapsulation of shoot tips of a woody species, jojoba [S. chinensis (Link)] Schneider for germplasm conservation and distribution.
the development of an efficient encapsulation method for germplasm storage of jojoba, which can be utilized for germplasm conservation, germplasm exchange, and distribution.
the development of an efficient protocol for in vitro propagation and encapsulation of jojoba shoot tips.

encapsulation of jojoba shoot tips is a simple, efficient and cost-effective technique that could be applied in germplasm exchange, distribution, and propagation of desirable elite genotypes of jojoba.
alginate-encapsulation technique is a simple, rapid and effective method for germplasm conservation and distribution in jojoba.
alginate encapsulation of shoot tips is an effective and efficient method for germplasm conservation, exchange, and distribution.

alginate encapsulation of shoot tips of elite genotypes of jojoba could be used for germplasm conservation, exchange and distribution.
